title: Gentle Shin Stroking
summary: Light passes are made over the soft tissues beside the shin bone.
goal: Include the lower leg gently without pressing on bone.
startingPosition: The leg is relaxed and supported.
instructions: Locate soft tissue beside the shin.
Reduce pressure near ankle and knee.
direction: Longitudinally over the soft tissues of the lower leg.
warning: Do not massage with acute pain, recent injury, marked swelling, or inflammation. One-sided swelling, redness, warmth, or calf pain should be medically assessed before massage.
